name: Bacchides
description: A friend of king Demetrius, who ruled beyond the flood (the Euphrates) and was a great man in the kingdom; sent with Alcimus against Israel, and slew threescore of the Assideans who had trusted Alcimus's oath

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
